description: Organized object paths for SquashCode Creative Studio image assets. Paths are relative to the bucket root.

generations.purpose: AI-generated creative output images from the Creative Generator

pathVariables.folderId: Creative folder UUID or literal uncategorized

primary.purpose: Primary reference images uploaded in the Prompt Generator (/prompt-generator)

supporting.purpose: Supporting reference images for prompt sessions

thumbnails.purpose: Derived preview or thumbnail images (future use)

publicAccess.read: Public read via storage public URL (bucket is public)
publicAccess.write: Backend service role uploads; authenticated users may upload under their own userId prefix when using the client directly
